# InfraCrackVision

Deep-learning-based four-class crack detection and crack-coverage severity estimation for concrete and pavement images.

## Classes
1. no-crack  2. minor  3. moderate  4. severe

## Current workflow
Place raw datasets in `datasets/`, inspect them, build one metadata CSV, derive coverage labels from masks where available, train the primary CNN, evaluate on an untouched test set, then run inference on new images.

## Setup
```bash
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1
# Linux/macOS: source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Run stages in this order:
```bash
python data/inspect_datasets.py
python data/build_metadata.py
python data/prepare_labels.py
python training/train_segmentor.py --epochs 2 --limit 32
python training/train_segmentor.py --epochs 30
python data/generate_pseudo_masks.py
```
The first segmentation smoke test must pass before the 30-epoch run. Pseudo-masks for SDNET2018 cracked images are generated only after `checkpoints/segmentor.pt` exists.

Raw data is intentionally excluded from the starter archive. See `docs/dataset_plan.md`.
